Name: Farm Cleaner
Author: cylixlee
Description:
[size=6]Farm Cleaner[/size]
[img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Android_Compatible-3DDC84?logo=android&logoColor=000000[/img][color=#e4e4e7][color=#e4e4e7] [/color][/color][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew_Valley_PC-1.6.15-138FBF[/img][color=#e4e4e7][color=#e4e4e7] [/color][/color][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew_Valley_Android-1.6.15-138FBF[/img][color=#e4e4e7][color=#e4e4e7] [/color][/color][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI_PC-4.5.2-ff781e[/img][color=#e4e4e7][color=#e4e4e7] [/color][/color][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI_Android-4.3.2.5-ff781e[/img]
[line]
Stardew Valley mod for cleaning the farm without hours of manual effort.

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/FarmCleaner/img/cleaner.jpg[/img]

Just press the hot key ([i]default[/i]: K) and wait for the debris to be collected. By default this only works on your farm, but non-farm areas can be enabled in the settings. It can also defeat monsters, smash barrels and crates, open mine treasure chests, and collect forage — with everything attracted to you — which is handy in the mines. You can change it in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url]. For Android players, you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29884]Virtual Keyboard[/url] mod.

[size=5]Settings[/size]
[line]
This mod provides the following settings.

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/FarmCleaner/img/settings.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Hot Key[/b][/size]

The key to clear all trees, stones, grass, and debris from your farm. Defaults to `K`.

[size=4][b]Enable On Non-Farm Areas[/b][/size]

Whether to allow clearing the current location outside the farm. Defaults to disabled. Use with care on custom maps.

[size=4][b]Gain Experience[/b][/size]

Whether to gain experience from clearing the farm. Defaults to enabled. When disabled, no experience is granted.

[size=4][b]Clear Monsters[/b][/size]

Whether to defeat all monsters in the current location. Defaults to enabled. Monsters that cannot normally be killed (like the invincible Spiker trap) are removed as well.

[size=4][b]Collect Forage[/b][/size]

Whether to collect all spawned forage items in the current location. Defaults to enabled. The items drop where they were and are attracted to you; when your backpack is full, the extra forage is dropped near you.

[spoiler][b] Containers [/b]

There is no separate setting: when you clear a location, barrels, crates, and mine/volcano treasure chests are broken automatically, and their contents are attracted to you. Your own chests and gift boxes are never touched.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Clear Grass[/b][/size]

Whether to clear grass. Defaults to disabled — grass will not be cleared.

[size=4][b]Clear Fruit Trees[/b][/size]

Whether to clear fruit trees. Defaults to disabled — fruit trees will not be cleared.

[size=4][b]Clear Tapped Trees[/b][/size]

Whether to clear trees that have a tapper attached. Defaults to disabled — tapped trees will not be cleared.

[size=4][b]Clear Growing Trees[/b][/size]

Whether to clear trees that are not yet fully grown. Defaults to disabled — saplings and young trees will not be cleared.

[size=4][b]Clear Giant Crops[/b][/size]

Whether to clear giant crops and meteorites. Defaults to disabled — giant crops and meteorites will not be cleared.

[size=4][b]Drop Multiplier[/b][/size]

A multiplier applied to the number of dropped items (wood, stone, fiber, etc). Defaults to 1. Range: 1 – 100.

This is extremely useful when you don't want to collect the basic resources repeatedly, and it's not that balance-breaking in my opinion. When your backpack is full, the artifacts will drop by.

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/FarmCleaner/img/overflow.jpg[/img]
